name: Cleoboea
domains: the Mysteries of Demeter on Thasos

summary.text: The maiden who first brought the orgies of Demeter to Thasos from Paros, shown on a painted chest among the first settlers of the island's cult.

story.text: Pausanias, describing a chest at the Amyclaean throne of Apollo, names Cleoboea among those on board the painted boat — still a maiden, holding on her knees a chest such as they make for Demeter — and records that she was the first to bring the orgies of Demeter to Thasos from Paros.
